topic.title: September inflation hits 5.54%: savings account versus FD, which one still beats prices

title: Prices are up 5.54% in a year. Does your savings account keep pace?
description: September's retail inflation came in at 5.54% (MoSPI). We put ₹1 lakh in a savings account at an assumed 3% and in an FD at an assumed 7% for 5 years, and compare both with prices rising at that pace. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
